name: Golden Gauntlets
description: Legendary golden gauntlets granting the strength to lift massive pillars and colossal blocks. The ultimate strength upgrade, found deep in Ganon's Castle.

customData.lore: Said to be forged from the golden scales of a dragon. The wearer can move mountains. Even the Hero of Time strains under their weight.
puzzleUses: Push gold blocks in Ganon's Castle
